rules: Preserve approved x/y coordinates exactly; projection never rewrites plan geometry.
Treat wall polygons as one even-odd wall topology, not independent solid polygons.
Use the aperture registry to classify wall gaps as windows or doors.
Do not fill a registered door aperture when extruding walls.
For registered windows, add provisional sill/lintel/glass geometry rather than leaving a floor-to-ceiling gap.
Window and door z dimensions are provisional and may change without altering aperture x/y spans.
PC tower is physically under the desk in z-space.
Microwave is physically above the stove/oven in z-space.
Camera yaw/pitch may change only after topology validation passes.
sanity_gate: Bedroom door remains in the approved location.
Living chair/couch/TV relationships match the top-down plan.
Registered windows remain semantic apertures rather than missing or filled walls.
White chair sits on the living rug and the rug stops before the couch.
Closet opening is treated as a double/folding door, not an anonymous wall gap.
